items.title: General Physician Consultations
items.summary: See a doctor for everyday health concerns, short-term illnesses and follow-up visits.
items.details: A consultation with a general physician is a sensible first step for most health concerns. The doctor will listen to your symptoms, examine you where needed and advise on next steps, which may include treatment, tests or a referral.
expectations: Describe your symptoms and when they started
Bring previous prescriptions, reports and a list of medicines you take
Call ahead to check consultation timings
items.availabilityNote: Please call to confirm consultation timings before you visit.

items.title: General Health Check-ups
items.summary: Routine check-ups to help you keep an eye on your health. Ask our team what a check-up includes.
items.details: Regular check-ups can help you and your doctor notice changes early. What a check-up includes depends on your age, health and the doctor's advice, so our team will explain the options when you enquire.
expectations: Tell us why you would like a check-up
Our team will explain what is available and any preparation needed
The doctor will go through your results with you
items.availabilityNote: What a check-up includes is confirmed by clinic staff when you enquire.

items.title: Diagnostic Services
items.summary: Ask whether the test you need is available. We will confirm availability and any preparation.
items.details: If your doctor has advised a test, or you would like to know whether a test can be done at the clinic, contact our team. We will confirm whether it is available, how to prepare and when to come in.
expectations: Share the name of the test, or your prescription if you have one
Our team confirms availability and preparation steps
Visit at the time agreed with our team
items.availabilityNote: Test availability is confirmed by clinic staff for each enquiry.

items.title: Pharmacy Services
items.summary: Ask our team about pharmacy availability when you call or visit.
items.details: If you would like to collect medicines at the clinic, please call first. Our team will let you know what is available.
items.availabilityNote: Pharmacy availability is subject to confirmation. Please call before visiting.
